title: The T-tensor of spherically symmetric Finsler metrics
summary: This paper is devoted to the study of the T-tensor associated with a spherically symmetric Finsler metric $F=uφ(r,s)$ on \(\mathbb{R}^n\). We derive a general expression for the T-tensor in terms of the scalar function \(φ(r, s)\) and its partial derivatives. Furthermore, we characterize all spherically symmetric Finsler metrics satisfying the so-called T-condition, that is, those for which the T-tensor vanishes.
